text:
haley: Hey, running into a weird onboarding snag for the community sample app (Ruby). `bundle install` fails on M1 with a native extension error for `ffi`. Error: `ERROR: Failed to build gem native extension.` Anyone seen this recently?

sam: ugh that one. Two quick checks: have you tried `bundle config set force_ruby_platform true` and then `bundle install`? also what Ruby version?

haley: Ruby 3.1.2 via asdf. Tried the force_ruby_platform trick and got past ffi but then the redwood gem fails at `extconf.rb` with: `cannot find -lssl` during compilation. Mac (arm) dev 😅

joy: For SSL on mac, usually `brew install openssl@1.1` and then `export LDFLAGS="-L/usr/local/opt/openssl@1.1/lib" CPPFLAGS="-I/usr/local/opt/openssl@1.1/include"` helped me. But we should not expect every user to set that.

matt: FWIW we ship a precompiled gem for linux x86, but we don't have mac/arm wheels for the redwood-ruby gem yet. It's on the backlog but low priority. We could add a fallback doc in the sample app README to avoid the 1st-run pain.

haley: That would help. Also noticed the Ruby SDK default retry behavior seems different from Python: the sample app retries 3 times in python but ruby seems to retry indefinitely on 429s unless you set `max_retries`. Is that intentional? It caught me off guard.

sam: Not intentional. We have a parity gap there. Ruby's client used an upstream HTTP client default that didn't cap retries. We changed python to default max_retries=3 last quarter. I'll file a tiny PR to set ruby default to 3 and expose via config.

joy: Thanks. Can you also add a quick note in the sample app bootstrap script: check for common native deps and print helpful hints (openssl, xcode cli tools, asdf/ruby versions)? Short checklist reduces support tickets.

matt: Agree. I'll add a `scripts/dev_check.sh` that runs simple checks and prints commands. Keep it optional.

devx-bot: CI: PR #4823 (ruby-sdk/retries-default) passed ✅ — test matrix included mac-arm build skipped (no wheel).

haley: Awesome. For now the workaround that worked for me: install openssl via brew, set env flags, `bundle config set force_ruby_platform true`, then `gem install redwood --platform=ruby`. After that sample app boots. I'll paste exact commands in the sample-app README once PRs land. Thanks y'all :thumbsup:

sam: please add a short note to the SDK troubleshooting section and link the PR. I can follow up to backport a tiny changelog entry so community users see the fix.

joy: If anyone wants, I can draft the README blurb and checklist tonight and open a docs PR.

haley: That'd be great — saved me a ton of time.

sam: tagging @matt to make sure we prioritise a tiny wheel/release or at least a documented workaround.

matt: noted. I'll queue a release task and update the backlog item to high-priority for dev experience.

haley: thanks — closing the loop here, will follow up with the README PR and paste the exact commands.
